title: Mass and energy: two accounts, one subtraction
germanTitle: Ist die Trägheit eines Körpers von seinem Energieinhalt abhängig?
description: Three pages that end with a body’s mass as a measure of its energy. Follow the two energy accounts, and the one subtraction that leads there.
